prompt: What is a static method in an interface?
choices: A method that belongs to all implementing classes
A utility method that belongs to the interface itself and is called via the interface name
A method that cannot be overridden
A method that is automatically inherited by all implementing classes
explanation: Interface static methods (Java 8+) are called via the interface: Validator.isValidEmail(str). They are NOT inherited by implementing classes. They are useful for factory methods or utilities related to the interface.
